tei:titleStmt.tei:title: / /yang zlog me'i spu gri las/phur gdab kyi man ngag gud du bkol ba bzhugs so/ /ya mā ri na mo/mthar bsgral las bya ba ni srog phur min pa'i gdab pha
/ /yang zlog me'i spu gri las/phur gdab kyi man ngag gud du bkol ba bzhugs so/ /ya mā ri na mo/mthar bsgral las bya ba ni srog phur min pa'i gdab pha

tei:div.tei:p: // yang zlog me'i spu gri las/ phur gdab kyi man ngag gud du bkol ba bzhugs so//ya mā ri na mo/ mthar bsgral las bya ba ni srog phur min pa'i gdab phur khro zhal yod pa phur sgrub logs su yod pa ltar rtags ldan du byas pa zhig lag pa thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du bzung la/ rang gi lag g.yas nyi ma dang g.yon zla ba g.yas pa'i sor mo lnga/ oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥlas rigs lnga/ g.yon pa'i sor mo lnga/ mūṃ lāṃ māṃ pāṃ tāṃ las yum lngar gsal ba'i yab yum sbyor ba mdzad pa'i byang sems las sprul pa'i rdo rje phur bu nag po las/ sras mchog ya mānta ka badzra kī la ya nag po rdo rje'i gshog pa can/ zhal gsum nag dkar dmar/ phyag g.yas gsum/ 'khor lo/ ral gri/ rdo rje/ g.yon gsum/ lcags kyu/ gtun shing*/ sdigs mdzub kyi tha ma gnyis rdo rje'i phur bu thugs kar bsgril ba/ dur khrod kyi chas brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ sku smad gnam lcags kyi phur bu mgar gyi sol mal nas bton pa lta bu me'i tsha tsha 'phro ba/ chu srin gyi kha nas phyung ba/ sbrul gyi chun po 'phyangs pa/ de dag gi sked pa rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i lte bar 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' yab yum/ yar gyi rwa lnga la rgyal ba rigs lnga yab yum/ mar gyi rwa lnga la khrag 'thung rigs lnga yab yum/ rgya mdud gong ma la yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams/ rgya mdud 'og ma la bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho/ dbal la gshin rje sde brgyad dregs pa'i dmag tshogs/ rtse mo zur gsum nas mtshon cha sna tshogs pa'i char 'bab pa/ sgril ba tsam gyis srid gsum 'dar zhing*/ phyar ba tsam gyis khams gsum dngangs par byed pa/ btab pa tsam gyis dgra bgegs brlag par nus pa zhig tu gyur par bsam/ oṃ ya mānta ka badzra kī li kī la ya kā ya wāka tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ āḥhūm̐/ phur bu las 'od 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba 'khor dang bcas pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs bsdus phur bu la thim pas/

sku bsgyings pa dang*/ gsung bsgrags pa dang*/ thugs g.yos pa tsam gyis khams gsum dus gcig la sgrol ba'i dbang dang ldan par gyur par bsam/ phur bu sgril zhing*/ hūm̐ */ nga ni 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed// g.yas pa thabs kyi rang bzhin can// rigs lnga yab lnga'i ngo bor gsal// g.yon pa shes rab rang bzhin can// rigs lnga yum lnga'i ngo bor gsal// thabs dang shes rab sbyar ba las// mthing nag hūm̐ las sprul pa'i sras// ya mānta ka kī la ya// sku stod khro rgyal chen po la// sku smad gnam lcags phur bu'i tshul// dus gsum bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sku// khams gsum sgrol mdzad kī la ya// dgra bgegs dug lnga dug gsum dang*// las dang nyon mongs tshar bcad nas// rgyal ba'i sras su rab sgrol ba'i// rdo rje phur bu mnga' gsol lo// na maḥs manta buddhā nāṃ kā ya wāka tsitta ya mānta ka badzra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces brjod/ slar yang phur bu khro zhal yod pa de nyid sgril zhing*/ hūm̐ */ chos kyi dbyings las rang byung grub pa'i lha// gshin rje rol pa'i dur khrod chen po na// shin tu mi bzad rab 'jigs skur ston pa// gshin rje yongs rdzogs drag po'i phrin las mdzod// oṃ ya mānta ka badzra kī li kī la ya badzra dha ra ādzñā pa ya ti dgra bgegs mā ra ya phaṭ/ ces bla gnas sar gdab/ slob dpon padmas mdzad pa'i gser phreng las/ mthu'i dam par dang po/ rang byang chub mchog tu sems skyed la gzhan don du snying rjes mthu bsgrubs la/ phur bu liṅga la rdeg khar zhe sdang bskyed cing sangs rgyas kyi phrin las kyi thabs yin no// zhes gsungs pas/ rgyu dus kyi kun slong byang chub kyi sems dang snying rjes kun nas bslangs shing de dus kyi kun slong zhe sdang drag po bskyed dgos pa yin no| |mchan/ de rjes snying ga'i nṛ la gdab cing*/ dbal phur tsam/

mchan/ gnas spar ba ni/ dgra bo las ngan 'dis sngar yang mi dge ba spyad pas 'khor bar 'khyams pa yin/ da yang yun ring bsdad na mi dge ba mang du spyod pas phyi ma ngan 'gror skye ba las 'os med/ de bas da lta las ngan rgyun bcad nas 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'i sras thob par bya'o snyam pa'i sems drag po bskyed/ e ma khams gsum sems can rnams// ma rtogs 'khrul pa snying re rje// snying rjes bsgral ba'i dam tshig ni gshin rje'i gshed nag po'i las thams cad grub par byed pa 'khor lo'i rgyud las/ de bas nan tan ldan pa ru// bzod pa mi bskyed snying rje yi// sngags kyis nges par bsad par bya// mi ldog pa yi sems su gnas// zhes dang*/ jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha la dpal nā ro pas gsungs pa/ ji ltar srid pa g.yos gyur kyang*// 'jam des phag sems ma dgos zhig /ji ltar pha ma bsad gyur kyang*// sdang tshig khro ba ma smra zhig /bstan pa 'jig pa'i dgra bo la'ang*// sdang tshig bsam ngan mi rgyu yi// snying rje chen pos bsgral bar bya// rang lus ji ltar brlag kyang rung*// sangs rgyas bstan pa de ltar min// ston pa'i bstan pa bsrung bya nyid// mkhas pa'i bya ba thabs mkhas nyid// gdams pa yin no dī paṃ gsungs| |zhes bka' gdams glegs bam pha chos su jo bos 'brom la gsungs 'dug go// bsad cing mnan pa ma yin te// thugs rje'i thabs shes sbyor ba yis// phung po bsgral nas zhal du bstab// rnam shes sangs rgyas sras su spar// oṃ ya mānta ka badzra kī li kī la ya a nṛ yaṃ spha ra ṇa phaṭ/ bo dhi tsitta nṛ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ zhes phur bu snying gar btab pas/ yid kyi rten rlung gi dwangs ma sngo skya byi'u'i mgo tsam gyi dbus su srog gi ngo bo nṛ rang rang gi lte bar kho la sngar bla mas dbang bskur dus gshin rje dmar nag 'bar ba'i dme rgyud kyi le'u dgu par/

dam tshig nyams pa'i sngags pa de'i// snying gar bla mas bstims pa yi| |ye shes sems dpa' bzhugs pa nyid// dam tshig srog gi lha yin pas// dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub ster// nyams na snying khrag 'jib pa'i 'dre// de la dam bdar mchod bshags la// dam tshig nyams pa'i gshed du gtang*// lcags kyi sdig pa mgo dgur gyur// snying rtsa brgyad nas za bar bsam// de la phur pa gdab par bya'o// zhes gsungs pa'i don no// ye shes sems dpa' bstims pa de nyid dam tshig bsrung na ye shes sems dpa' yin la/ dam las nyams na las kyi gshin rje'i gshed po yin pas ye shes sems dpa' de lcags kyi sdig pa mgo dgu par gyur te/ snying rtsa brgyad nas za zhing snying khrag 'thung*/ phur bu'i rtse mo nas 'od 'phros pas rlung gi dwangs ma sngo skya de gtor/ khrag gi dwangs ma 'ubs kyis bskams/ de ma thag kho'i 'byung ba'i khams sa chu la thim/ chu me la/ me rlung la/ rlung rnam shes kyi ngo bo nṛ la thim ma thag nṛ de nyid phur bu'i rtse mor 'ubs kyis 'dus pa phur bu'i khong gseng nas brgyud rdo rje'i lte ba'i 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' yab kyi thugs kar nṛ de nyid a dkar po'i rnam par bstims pas chos skur sangs rgyas/ slar 'jam dpal yab yum sbyor ba mdzad pa'i tshe a de nyid yab kyi dbu ma'i lam brgyud rdo rje'i lam nas yab yum gyi mkha' gsang du bab pas 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'i sras su gyur te lho phyogs rdul bral yang dag brtsegs kyi zhing du longs skur sangs rgyas/ des sprul pa dpag tu med pa bkyes te khams gsum pa'i 'gro ba rnams sgrol ba'i don gnyis grub pa'i sprul skur sangs rgyas par bsam/ yang phur bu kho'i snying gar btab pas kho'i tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor thams cad phur bu'i khong gseng nas brgyud rang gi snying gar thim pas/ bdag gi tshe bsod dpal 'byor stobs dang gzi brjid rgyas par byas/

kho'i snying nang gi ye shes sems dpa' yang phur bu'i khong gseng nas brgyud chang bzung gi rdo rje'i lte ba'i 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' la thim par gyur par bsam zhing phur bu sngar phur sgrub byas pa khro zhal can de nyid gnas rnams su dbal nub pa tsam du/ mchan/ btab cing*/ hūm̐ */ stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten na// lho phyogs stong gi 'jig rten na// drag pos sgrol mdzad phur bu ni// sku stod phyag rgya zil gnon la// sku smad lcags phur zur gsum 'bar// stobs chen 'dus pa'i mtshon cha yis// dgra bgegs 'khor ba rtsad gcod phyir// lte ba'i dkyil du kī la ya// lus kyi rnam shes rten dang phrol// lus kyi 'khrul ba rtsad nas chod// mgrin pa'i dkyil du kī la ya| |ngag gi rnam shes rten dang phrol// ngag gi 'khrul ba rtsad nas chod// mig gi dkyil du kī lā ya// mig gi rnam shes rten dang phrol// gzugs su 'khrul ba rtsad nas chod// sna yi dkyil du kī la ya// sna yi rnam shes rten dang phrol// dri ru 'khrul ba rtsad nas chod// rna ba'i dkyil du kī la ya// rna ba'i rnam shes rten dang phrol// sgra ru 'khrul ba rtsad nas chod// lce yi dkyil du kī la ya/ lce yi rnam shes rten dang phrol// ro ru 'khrul ba rtsad nas chod// gsang ba'i dkyil du kī la ya// kun gzhi'i rnam shes rten dang phrol// 'khor bar 'khrul ba rtsad nas chod| |yan lag bzhi la kī la ya// reg bya'i rnam shes rten dang phrol// reg byar 'khrul ba rtsad nas chod// oṃ ya mānta ka badzra kī la ya dgra bgegs mā ra ya/ nā sha ya/ st+waṃ bha ya/ mo ha ya/ bhandha ya/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces gdab/ kho'i rnam shes tshogs brgyad phur bu la thim/ phur bu 'od du zhu lha rnams la thim/ lha rnams 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' la thim/ 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' bdag la thim par gyur par bsam mo// de ltar tshe lung khrus lung gi rjes su gso ba gsum las/

bdag gso ba ni/ oṃ yamānta ka hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces brgya phrag dang*/ hūm̐ brgya phrag bzlas pas/ khams gsum hūm̐ gis gang hūm̐ de rnams rang la khams gsum gyi skye 'gro mchog dman gyi tshe bsod dpal 'byor phun tshogs thams cad kyang bsdus te rang la thim par bsam/ thim pas/ rang nyid phyag rgya zil gnon sku che zhing yan lag rags pa stong gsum gang ba zhig tu gyur par bsam/ phur bu gso ba ni/ yang*/ oṃ ya mānta ka hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces bzlas pas/ phur bu de las phur bu grangs med pa 'phros khams gsum phur bus gang*/ dgra bgegs thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus/ phur bu la thim pas phur bu mthu stobs gzi mdangs nus pa dang ldan par gyur par bsam/ dgra gso ba ni/ oṃ ya mānta ka hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces bzlas pas/ sngags kyi 'od zer liṅga'i snying khar phog pas tshogs brgyad kyi sgrib pa nyes ltung thams cad sbyangs nas/ kho 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed du gyur ma thag rlung rdo rje rgya gram gyis bteg nas/ lho phyogs rdul bral yang dag brtsegs kyi zhing du 'jam dpal yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams su 'phangs pas rgyal ba'i sras su skyes par gyur par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ brgya phrag gcig bzlas pas sku gsum thob par bsam pa'o// 'di yan smad las dru bu 'thul ba lta bu bsgral 'dren mthar thug pa yin la/ 'di phyis kho'i rnam smin gyi lus sgyu ma lta bu bag chags dang bcas pa re tshabs byed pa ltar bsgral nas sha khrag lha rnams la tshogs 'khor dga' ston du 'bul ba yin no// skabs 'dir bla phur mi'i mchog phur/ mchan/ bla 'gugs pa'i sngags bzla zhing bla gnas dbal nub par/ mchan/ sar gdab/ snying phur seng ldeng phur bu/ mchan/ snying dbyung ba'i sngags bzla zhing snying gar gdab/ dbal nub par/ mchan/ srog phur gri lcags kyi phur pa/ mchan/ srog gcod pa'i sngags dang bsad sngags bzla zhing bla gnas sa dang gnas spyi bo dpral mgrin snying lte gsang mig sna lce rna ba rkang lag gi tshigs bcu gnyis|

mchan/ rnams su dbal nub par/ mchan/ gdab/ de'ang zlog bsad kyi 'khor lo dang ming rkyang rnams la phur bu dbal nub tsam gdab/ gtad mnan gyi 'khor lo la rma thon tsam gdab bo// de nas so bsdebs kyi dregs bskul dang zla gsang gi thun bskul byas la thun brab/ lcags sam bhandhas gtor zor brdeg go// slar gdab phur khro zhal yod pa sngar phur sgrub byas pa de nyid thogs la/ phur bu'i dbal nas 'don cha dang mtshungs pa'i mtshon cha rnams spros nas dgra bo'i lus ngag yid gsum thal bar brlag par bsam zhing*/ hūm̐ */ nga ni 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed// nyon mongs bag chags kyis rnyogs pa'i// dug gsum gyis mnar khyod gzigs nas// 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed po yis| |snying rjes khyod nyid bsgral ba'i phyir// dza dzaḥgaza' bzhin spros nas kyang*// bkug cing rdo rje'i mtshon chas bsgral// rdo rje phur bu'i rtse mo nas// zhe sdang rtsad gcod rdo rje'i mtshon// drag po thog gi char ltar phob// hūm̐ e dzaḥ lcags ha cang spros pa la dga' na 'don cha dang mtshungs pa'i mtshon cha re re nas liṅga la rdeg kyang nyan pa tsam mo// kyu 'bar ba'i tshogs spros pas| |khug cig badzra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ zhags pa 'bar ba'i tshogs spros pas// chings shig badzra pā sha hūm̐// lcags sgrog 'bar ba'i tshogs spros pas// sdoms shig badzra spho ṭa baṃ// dril bu 'bar ba'i tshogs spros pas// phob cig badzra ghaṇṭe hoḥ /rdo rje 'khor lo'i tshogs spros pas// gtubs shig badzra tsakra ṇa// rdo rje ral gri'i tshogs spros pas// gshogs shig badzra khaḍga hoḥ /rdo rje rtse dgu'i tshogs spros pas// rdul du rlogs shig badzre ṇa// rdo rje lcags kyu'i tshogs spros pas// myur du khug cig nṛ tri dzaḥ /rdo rje gtun shing tshogs spros pas// rdungs shig badzra mu kha la| |rdo rje sdigs mdzub tshogs spros pas// gzir cig badzra tardza ni// mchil pa 'bar ba'i tshogs spros pas// drongs shig badzra ā na ya// thod khrag 'bar ba'i tshogs spros pas// myos par gyis shig parta ka ra// bshan gri 'bar ba'i tshogs spros pas// sgrol cig badzra tstshindha na// tsitta 'bar ba'i tshogs spros pas// nyams par gyis shig bi ruddha// ri rab 'bar ba'i tshogs spros pas/

rnam par gnon cig krānta ku ru// dgra sta 'bar ba'i tshogs spros pas// khos shig badzra parshu pa// be con 'bar ba'i tshogs spros pas// rgyob cig badzra ta ḍa ya// zhags pa 'bar ba'i tshogs spros pas// dam por sdom shig bhandha na// gzhan yang sprul pa'i pho nya'i tshogs// mtshon cha sna tshogs rab 'bar bas// phog par rgyob cig ta ḍa ya// gnad du snun cig pu tsi ya// myur du sod cig mā ra ya// sha la zo zhig bhuñdza tha// khrag la 'thung zhig pi ba tha// rus la mur zhig bhakṣa ya// nang grol choms shig pañdza na// klad pa stobs shig kha raṃ khā hi// phrin las sgrubs shig kāraya hoḥ zhes dbal nub par rdeg /de nas mi bsad pa'i mtshon chas rdeg cing*/ hūm̐ */ nga ni dus gsum bzhugs pa yi// sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku// ye shes rno ba'i mtshon cha ni| |thogs med drag po las kyi mtshon// rdo rje'i me chen rab 'bar bas// nyon mongs las kyis rab mnar ba'i// dgra bgegs log rtog dug lnga'i tshogs// 'khor ba'i skye rgyud rtsad nas chod| |oṃ mant+ra suṃ bha badzra dzwa la/ oṃ bhrūṃ/ hūm̐ bhrūṃ/ trāṃ bhrūṃ/ hrīḥbhrūṃ/ āḥbhrūṃ/ tshal pa tshal pa/ mā ra ya dza dzaḥ zhes zlog bsad kyi 'khor lo dang liṅga rnams dum bur bsgral/ gtad mnan gyi 'khor lo rnams bsgral ba'i tshul tsam ma gtogs dngos su mi bsgral lo// de nas zan ling gcig dang bsgral ba'i ling ro rnams gtun khung gru gsum pa'i nang bcug la rdo rje'i tho bas brdung zhing*/ gtun khung yum gyi bha gar tho ba yab kyi rdo rjes brdungs pas dgra bo'i nyon mongs pa rtsad nas bcad de rgyal ba'i sras su skyes par bsams la/ hūm̐ dzaḥ rdungs shig rdo rje 'bar ba'i gtun// bka' las 'da' byed sdig can 'di// rdo rje'i mtshon chas bsgral nas kyang*// khro mo 'bar ba'i gtun khung du// rdo rje'i tho bas brdungs byas la// lha yang rung ste brlag par byed// dgra bgegs rnams la smos ci dgos// nyams pa'i tshe srog lus ngag yid// thal ba'i rdul du brlag par bgyi'o// oṃ badzra kro dha ā ko ṭa ya/

kha thaṃ kha thaṃ/ mchu chings mchu chings/ zhes nyer gcig bzlas la brdungs/ mthar/ bgegs dang log par 'dren pa sogs dang*/ nam mkha' med pa sogs bden pa brjod do// de nas ling ro cung zad gcig gtor mar bsgron sman raka bran la bstab bo tshogs tha ma'i skabs ltar bya/ ling ro lhag ma rnams gdug pa me'i las sbyor ltar sbyin sreg bya'o| |de ltar tshe khrus lung gi dgongs pa rnam par dag pas dgra bo bsgral na nyes pa mi 'byung ba'i steng gzhan don dam par 'gyur pa ni/ gshin rje'i gshed nag po'i rgyud las/ e ma hoḥgasang ba'i yang dag gsang*// bsad pa ma yin sdig las bkrol// ji srid bsad kyang ma bsad de// sdig pa stong phrag byas pa yi// mnar med la sogs mi skye ba// e ma hoḥsangs rgyas che ba'i bdag /bsad pas byang chub thob par byed// sems can gsod pa bsad pa nyid// snying rje chen po nyid kyis byas// e ma hoḥsnying rje stobs kyi mchog /snying rje dman pas 'grub mi 'gyur// zhes gsungs so// gshin rje dgra nag gi rgyud paṇḍi ta thugs rje chen po dang lo tsā ba rwa rdo rje grags kyi 'gyur/ phyis paṇḍi ta sa manta shrī dang lo tsā ba rwa chos rab kyis 'gyur bcos mdzad pa las/ 'di ltar bsad pa sangs rgyas kyi// sras su de ni skye bar 'gyur// las kyi sdig las de grol lo// gshin rje'i gshed nag po'i las thams cad grub par byed pa 'khor lo'i rgyud bā ro phyag rdum dang rwa rdo rje grags kyis bsgyur bar yang lung 'di kho na 'dug go// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro// gnad 'di dang ldan na drag po mngon spyod kyi phrin las la nan tan bgyis na sngags pa hom khung nang 'tshang mi rgya ka med pa yin no// phur bu rnams gdab pa'i tshe zlog bsad kyi 'khor lo dang*/ ling rkyang la phur bu dbal nub nges su gdab/ gtad mnan gyi 'khor lo slar bcas nang du 'jug rgyu yin na phur rtse yod tsam gdab/

dbal nub par mi gdab/ slar mnan gtad sgrub pa zin nas tshur phyung ste gtad chas dang mnan chas byed ran khar phur bu dbal nub par gdab bo// tshe bdag zla gsang 'dus pa'i tant+ra'i le'u lnga pa nyams pa bsgral ba'i skabs su/ bsgral ba'i thabs ni rnam gsum ste// rtogs pa lta bas bsgral ba dang*// bsnyen sgrub cho gas bsgral ba dang*// rbod gtong pho nyas bsgral ba'o// blo rab lta ba'i rnal 'byor gyis// rig pa chos nyid dbyings la gzung*// ngan song gsum gyi phung po de// 'dul sbyong gsum gyis gnas sbyang na// de nyid dag pa'i zhing du 'gyur// bsnyen sgrub cho gas bsgral ba ni// gshin rje gshed kyi gnas chen du// bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor tshul bzhin bya// drag po'i mchod rten bcas nas ni// gnas ngan bsgral ba'i las rnams kyi// drag po'i bsnyen sgrub 'di lta ste// bsnyen dang sgrub dang las sbyor gsum// rab 'bring tha ma gsum dang sbyar// dngos dang nyams dang rmi lam gsum// shin tu rtags thub ston par bya// rtags dang mtshan ma phyin pa dang*// drag po'i thun gyis bsgral bar bya// pho nyas bsgral bar bya ba yang*// srod dang tho rangs nyin mtshan dgong*// bla 'gugs pho nya 'di dag gtang*// zhes bsgral lugs gsum gsungs pa ltar gsum ga yang zlog las sbyor sgrub pa la tshang bas shin tu yid ches nges shes skyes pas lung 'di 'dir khol bur bris pa yin no// deng sang gangs can ljongs 'dir chos pa 'ga'// btsun gzugs 'thab rtsod bslu ham dug sbyor sogs// nyams len sdig la byas nas rang gzhan phung*| |'ga' zhig jo bzang byas pas kun gyis brnyas// de bas rdo rje theg pa'i khyad par chos// thabs mang sems can zhi bas mi thul ba// sangs rgyas bstan dang slob dpon la sdang zhing*// rnal 'byor la 'tshe zhing bcur gyur pa rnams// las ka 'di 'dra tshar bcad rjes bzung ba/

/tshe 'dir rang bde dkon mchog dbu 'phang mtho/ /kho yi las ngan 'khor ba rgyun bcad nas// bde bar bkod pas 'gro don zla bral grub// phyi ma hom khung nang nas sngags 'chang bdag /sangs rgyas grub pas don gnyis shugs la 'byung*| |'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi khyad par chos// gsod lugs 'di 'dra kun gyis shes par shog/ //sarba maṅgalaṃ//
